title: 'SWIM' Claims 7th No. 1 on Billboard Global (Excl. US) — 10th Consecutive Week on Hot 100
detail: In the Billboard chart cycle dated May 30, 2026, BTS's 'SWIM' reaches No. 1 on the Billboard Global (Excl. US) chart for a seventh time in the 2026 calendar year — including three consecutive weeks at the top — confirmed by Starnews Korea and The Asia Business Daily on May 28–29. The achievement extends BTS's own annual record for most No. 1 weeks on that chart in a single calendar year, surpassing Taylor Swift's previous mark the week prior. Simultaneously, 'SWIM' ranks No. 55 on the Billboard Hot 100 in its 10th consecutive charting week — an all-time K-pop record on that survey — and No. 10 on the Billboard Global 200. All 13 of ARIRANG's vocal tracks remain on Billboard's global charts for a ninth consecutive week, representing the longest sustained K-pop album global chart run in chart history. The chart data publishes as BTS concludes the Las Vegas leg of the ARIRANG World Tour (May 23–28, four sold-out nights at Allegiant Stadium, ~260,000 fans) and enters a travel period heading to South Korea ahead of their Busan Asiad Main Stadium debut-anniversary shows on June 12–13.

media.caption: BTS 'SWIM' tops Billboard Global (Excl. US) for a 7th time in 2026 — 10th consecutive Hot 100 charting week — May 29, 2026

title: BTS ARIRANG World Tour Asia & Australia Leg — ARMY Presale Opens June 2; 18-Show Run from Kaohsiung to Manila
detail: With the Las Vegas residency now complete, the ARMY membership presale for the Asia and Australia legs of the ARIRANG World Tour opens Tuesday, June 2, 2026, with the general on-sale beginning June 4 (Kaohsiung, Melbourne, Sydney), June 5 (Kuala Lumpur, Singapore), and June 11 (Bangkok, Jakarta, Hong Kong, Bulacan) at btsworldtourofficial.com. The Asia-Pacific extension of the tour — announced May 22 by Big Hit Music and Live Nation — runs from November 19, 2026 through March 14, 2027. Confirmed dates and venues: Kaohsiung National Stadium, Taiwan (November 19, 21–22); Rajamangala National Stadium, Bangkok (December 3, 5–6); National Stadium, Singapore (December 17, 19–20, 22); Gelora Bung Karno Main Stadium, Jakarta (December 26–27); Marvel Stadium, Melbourne (February 12–13, 2027); Accor Stadium, Sydney (February 20–21, 2027); and Philippine Sports Stadium, Bulacan (March 13–14, 2027). Hong Kong dates are also confirmed. Visa, the Worldwide Tour Sponsor, is providing ARMY presale access across all Asia Pacific venues. The full ARIRANG World Tour now spans 85+ dates in 34 cities across 23 countries — the largest stadium tour in K-pop history, projected to gross approximately $1.8 billion. BTS is currently in transit from Las Vegas to South Korea ahead of the Busan Asiad Main Stadium anniversary shows on June 12–13.

media.caption: BTS ARIRANG World Tour Asia & Australia leg — ARMY presale opens June 2, 2026; shows from Kaohsiung to Manila (Nov 2026–Mar 2027)
